title: Liberty Science Center

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Liberty Science Center is a prime destination for learners of all ages. Our amazing Jennifer Chalsty Planetarium, dynamic exhibits, exotic animals, and phenomenal live science demonstrations make for an unforgettable experience. Our education programs can enhance your field trip with standards-aligned, highly interactive workshops, available for students from Pre-K through high school. For general field trips email groups@lsc.org or fill out this form. For field trips with STEM Education programming email partnerships@lsc.org or fill out this form. Explore science and technology in our Center for Learning and Teaching. We offer a range of standards-aligned workshops for grades PreK-12.

services.name: General Admission
services.desc: Explore astronomy and space science in the immersive environment of our 89-foot dome or on your own screen. View stunning astronomical objects and celestial phenomena from Earth’s surface and then travel into space to explore them close up. Gain a better conceptual understanding by flying up to, around, and through the objects. Observe changes in Moon phases, reasons for the seasons, the nature of the planets, and tour the distant universe without ever leaving your seat! Available at LSC. Join Big Bird and Elmo as they explore shapes in the sky and even go on a trip to the moon!
